Iconic Super Groundcar. Upgrades: Bulletproof Glass, Communications Center, Deployable Spike Strip [x2], TUp (Groundcar Compatible) Enhanced Interface Plug Integration, Improved Engine, Light Armored Chassis, NOS [x3], Reinforced Tires, TUp (Hardwired Locks) Security Upgrade (Advanced). Also: TUp (Improved) Racing Tires. No Heavy Chassis or Seating Upgrade. Racing tires: +2 to Maneuvers on pavement. Plugged in, a Maneuver takes only your Action. Without REF 8+ or active Speedware, −8 to Drive Land Vehicle. Miss a Drive Land Vehicle Check by 5 or less and its guidance computer rerolls it at Skill Base 14. In a chase (Hot Pursuit), once per chase make a DV15 Positioning Check to jump 2 squares ahead.

Cost: Super Luxury • Legends can’t be bought, choomba. (Cannot be fabricated. Must be gifted or scavenged)
Nomad: 10
